Q. 1 سَنْبَلَ الزَّرْعُ The seed-produce put forth its سُنْبُل [or ears]; (M, K;) as also أَسْبَلَ [q. v.]: the former of the dial. of Temeem, and the latter of that of El-Hijáz. (TA.) ＝
-A2- سَنْبَلَ ثَوْبَهُ, (K,) inf. n. سَنْبَلَةٌ, (TA,) He (a man) dragged a shirt of his garment behind him; so says Khálid Ibn-Jembeh: (TA:) or he dragged his garment behind him or before him. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
